description: This file defines a utility class `Projector` for projecting 3D objects onto 2D screen space and retrieving current OpenGL matrices. It is part of an Android graphics sample demonstrating OpenGL ES functionalities.

classes.name: Projector
classes.description: A utility class that provides projection of 3D objects to 2D screen coordinates and retrieval of current OpenGL projection and model-view matrices.

methods.name: Projector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the projection and view matrices.

methods.name: setCurrentView
methods.description: Sets the viewport dimensions and position.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Projects a 3D object coordinate to screen space.

methods.name: getCurrentProjection
methods.description: Retrieves the current OpenGL projection matrix.

methods.name: getCurrentModelView
methods.description: Retrieves the current OpenGL model-view matrix.
